The company provides oil and gas infrastructure services, including combined station works, midstream and downstream pipeline projects, and other allied services; electrical, instrumentation, and cathodic protection; non-destructive testing, pressure testing, and certification of pipelines and piping; and civil infrastructure solutions, including site development, grading, road and pavement construction, foundations, drainage systems, boundary walls, and utility buildings. It also offers design, engineering, procurement, construction, testing, and commissioning services for oil and gas stations, cross-country pipelines, spur pipelines, city gas stations, and related civil and mechanical works. Vectras Enprocon Limited was formerly known as Vectras Enprocon Private Limited and changed its name to Vectras Enprocon Limited in April 2025. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

listings.name: VIVEKANAND COTSPIN LIMITED
listings.about: Vivekanand Cotspin Limited engages in cotton processing and yarn manufacturing in India and internationally. The company's products include raw cotton bales, cotton yarn waste, cotton seeds, and cotton yarn, including both combed compact yarn and carded compact yarn. The company operates in two primary areas, cotton ginning and spinning. Its ginning process includes separating cotton fibers from seeds, and its spinning process includes converting cotton fibers into yarn. Its products are used by textile mills for weaving and knitting fabrics. The company caters to both domestic and international markets. The company exports its products to Bangladesh, China, Egypt, Vietnam, and Portugal. It also operates solar power plant. Vivekanand Cotspin Limited was founded in 1999 and is based in Mehsana, India.
